senses.gloss:
मृकण्ड मृकण्ड, अस्, or मृकण्डु, उस्, m.,
N. of an ancient sage, the father of Mārkaṇḍeya.
मृक्ष् मृक्ष् = rt. म्रक्ष्, q. v.

मृक्ष, अस्, m., Ved. (perhaps) a curry-comb,
comb or any instrument for scraping; (according to
Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 66, 3) purifying, cleansing;
rubbed, cleansed (= शोधक, प्र-क्षालित).
मृक्षक-नाटक, अम्, n., N. of a Nāṭaka.

मृक्षिणी, f. (perhaps fr. rt. म्रक्ष्, in the sense
of ‘tearing up the ground’), Ved. (perhaps) a rapid
stream, torrent.
